text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 8: When 30% steps were planted in 17 plant-months, the Kalman filter recovered most of the oracle's gain'
text.tspan: Figure 8: When 30% steps were planted in 17 plant-months, the Kalman
filter recovered most of the oracle's gain

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error against B0, when a 30% loss is planted in power in up to 3 months at every plant. The oracle divides by the true loss. The Kalman filter recovered 0.89 of the oracle's gain, net of its real-data change. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Hollow triangle: the Kalman filter on the real, unplanted data. The control shows the instrument can detect a loss.'
text.tspan: Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error against B0, when a 30% loss is planted in power in up to 3
months at every plant. The oracle divides by the true loss. The Kalman filter recovered 0.89 of the oracle's gain,
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Hollow triangle: the Kalman filter on the real,
unplanted data. The control shows the instrument can detect a loss.
